name: Book Issue Report
query:
SELECT
    `tabSales Invoice`.`customer` as `Customer:Link/Customer:150`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`posting_date` as `Issue Date:Date:100`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`return_date` as `Return Date:Date:100`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`overdue_penalty` as `Overdue Penalty:Int:130`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`penalty_template` as `Penalty Template:Link/Penalty Template:135`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`penalty_amount` as `Penalty Amount:Data:125`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`penalty_total_amount` as `Penalty Total Amount:Int:160`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`is_penalty` as `Is Penalty:Check:90`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`is_return` as `Is Return:Check:90`,
    `tabSales Invoice`.`total_qty` as `Total Books:FLoat:100`
    FROM    
        `tabSales Invoice`
